# unifi_network_wan (Resource)

A WAN uplink (`networkconf` with `purpose=wan`): DHCP/PPPoE/static, dual-WAN load balancing, failover, smart-queue QoS, MAC clone, and IPv6. WAN interfaces are usually fixed in hardware — import the existing WAN/WAN2 and manage its configuration.

## Example Usage

```terraform
# A WAN uplink is usually fixed in hardware — import the existing WAN/WAN2 and
# manage its configuration rather than creating one.
resource "unifi_network_wan" "primary" {
  name          = "WAN"
  wan_type      = "dhcp"
  network_group = "WAN"
  enabled       = true

  # Override DNS (leave empty for automatic/ISP-provided).
  dns_servers = ["1.1.1.1", "8.8.8.8"]

  # Advertised ISP bandwidth (kbit/s) — used for smart-queue / load balancing.
  upload_kilobits   = 40000
  download_kilobits = 1000000
}

# A second uplink configured as failover only.
resource "unifi_network_wan" "backup" {
  name              = "WAN2"
  wan_type          = "dhcp"
  network_group     = "WAN2"
  load_balance_type = "failover-only"
}

# A PPPoE uplink (e.g. many DSL/fibre ISPs). pppoe_password is write-only.
resource "unifi_network_wan" "dsl" {
  name           = "WAN"
  wan_type       = "pppoe"
  pppoe_username = "user@isp.example"
  pppoe_password = var.isp_password # sensitive
}

# A static-IP uplink.
resource "unifi_network_wan" "static" {
  name     = "WAN"
  wan_type = "static"
  ip       = "203.0.113.2"
  netmask  = "255.255.255.0"
  gateway  = "203.0.113.1"
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `name` (String) WAN name.
- `wan_type` (String) Uplink type: `dhcp`, `pppoe`, or `static`.

### Optional

- `dns_servers` (List of String) Up to two IPv4 DNS servers. Setting any switches DNS to manual; empty uses automatic.
- `download_kilobits` (Number) Advertised ISP download bandwidth (kbit/s).
- `enabled` (Boolean) Whether the uplink is enabled.
- `failover_priority` (Number) Failover priority (lower wins) when `load_balance_type=failover-only`.
- `gateway` (String) Static WAN gateway (`wan_type=static`).
- `igmp_proxy_for` (String) IGMP-proxy downstream network.
- `igmp_proxy_upstream` (Boolean) Whether this uplink is the IGMP-proxy upstream.
- `ip` (String) Static WAN IP address (`wan_type=static`).
- `ipv6_delegation_type` (String) IPv6 prefix-delegation type (`none`, `dhcpv6`, …).
- `ipv6_dns_servers` (List of String) Up to two IPv6 DNS servers. Setting any switches IPv6 DNS to manual.
- `ipv6_enabled` (Boolean) Whether IPv6 is enabled on the uplink.
- `ipv6_pd_size` (Number) IPv6 prefix-delegation size.
- `ipv6_type` (String) IPv6 uplink type (`wan_type_v6`, e.g. `disabled`, `dhcpv6`, `static`).
- `load_balance_type` (String) Multi-WAN role: `weighted` (load balance) or `failover-only`.
- `load_balance_weight` (Number) Load-balance weight (0–100) when `load_balance_type=weighted`.
- `mac_override` (String) Clone this MAC address on the WAN interface (empty disables MAC override).
- `netmask` (String) Static WAN netmask (`wan_type=static`).
- `network_group` (String) WAN interface group: `WAN` (primary) or `WAN2`.
- `pppoe_password` (String, Sensitive) PPPoE password (`wan_type=pppoe`). Write-only — the controller does not return it, so it is not refreshed on read or recoverable on import.
- `pppoe_username` (String) PPPoE username (`wan_type=pppoe`).
- `report_wan_event` (Boolean) Whether WAN up/down events are reported.
- `smartq_down_rate` (Number) Smart-queue download limit (kbit/s).
- `smartq_enabled` (Boolean) Whether smart-queue QoS is enabled on this uplink.
- `smartq_up_rate` (Number) Smart-queue upload limit (kbit/s).
- `upload_kilobits` (Number) Advertised ISP upload bandwidth (kbit/s), used for smart-queue/load-balancing.
- `vlan_id` (Number) 802.1Q VLAN tag for the uplink (2–4094). Omit for untagged.

### Read-Only

- `id` (String) Controller object ID (`_id`). Import key.
- `routing_table_id` (Number) Routing table ID assigned by the controller (read-only).
- `setting_preference` (String) Controller auto/manual settings toggle (read-only).
- `single_network_lan` (String) LAN this uplink is bound to (read-only).

## Import

Import is supported using the following syntax:

The [`terraform import` command](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/cli/commands/import) can be used, for example:

```shell
# WAN uplinks are networkconf documents (purpose=wan); import by controller `_id`.
terraform import unifi_network_wan.primary 661f3a9c2b4d5e0012ab34ce
```
